LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryGenerationModule.label: make battery self-generation module
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryGenerationModule.descripti:
Passing off the electrical output of a walnut-sized cat brain as "self-generation"—just another peaceful day on the Rim.
Generate 1/100 of effective storage capacity in Wd per day, at least 25 W per module. Each upgrade level adds 25% of this base output, up to level V. Upgrade levels follow the physical module when it is removed and installed again.
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryStorageModule.label: make battery high-capacity storage module
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryStorageModule.description:
We tortured an alien into giving up an absurd revolution in energy conservation!
Add 10,000 Wd of storage and increase the capacity gained from each base upgrade by 50%. These bonuses add per installed copy.
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryCoilModule.label: make battery wireless power module
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryCoilModule.description:
Radiates intense electromagnetic waves to supply power wirelessly. There go the neighborhood property values...
Supply electrical consumers within 40 cells through the battery power network without connecting wires. Each upgrade adds 5 cells of range, up to 65 cells at level V. Upgrade levels follow the physical module when it is removed and installed again.
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryProtectionModule.label: make battery surge protection module
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryProtectionModule.descripti:
Why on earth did they build a simple diode and surge protector this huge?
Protect this battery's stored electricity from power-network short circuits and prevent component breakdowns.
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryReserveModule.label: make battery emergency reserve module
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryReserveModule.description:
Sooner or later, there comes a moment when you desperately need a quick CTRL + S!
Store an additional 20% of ordinary capacity as emergency reserve. Charge it from surplus electricity and release it when the network is short of power. Two copies keep the same reserve fraction.
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryEfficiencyModule.label: make battery charging-efficiency module
LanguageData.MT_MakeBatteryEfficiencyModule.descripti:
Wired the cells in series to boost charging efficiency! Great for fast charging—just hope TSA doesn't mistake it for an IED.
Set charging efficiency to 100%. One installed copy provides the full effect. This module cannot be upgraded.
